name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted web interface for searching and requesting books and audiobooks across configurable sources, with multi-user requests and a download queue.

alerts.message: Authentication is off by default, so anyone who reaches the URL can use the app. Right after deploying, create an admin under Settings > Users & Requests, then select Local under Settings > Security.
Direct Download launches a bundled Chromium browser; give the server at least 2 GB of free RAM if you use it.
